comparisons.peer_summary: The Company maintained a valuation allowance of approximately $2.1 billion for federal, state, and foreign tax attributes, primarily due to IRC Section 382/383 limitations or lack of sufficient future taxable income sources.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and AMD report maintaining valuation allowances against deferred tax assets due to uncertainties regarding future realization. Intel established a valuation allowance against US federal deferred tax assets in Q3 2024 based on a three-year cumulative loss position from impairments and restructuring. In contrast, AMD maintained a valuation allowance of approximately $2.1 billion for federal, state, and foreign attributes primarily due to IRC Section 382/383 limitations or lack of sufficient future taxable income sources, rather than recent cumulative losses.

sentences.text: Our effective tax rate increased in 2024 compared to 2023, primarily driven by the effects associated with the establishment of a valuation allowance against our US federal deferred tax assets in 2024.

As a result of our assessment in the third quarter of 2024, we determined it was more likely than not that the deferred tax assets will not be recoverable based upon our three-year cumulative historical loss position as of the third quarter of 2024, largely resulting from the asset impairment and restructuring and other charges incurred during 2024.
Through the end of fiscal year 2024, the Company continued to maintain a valuation allowance of approximately $2.1 billion for certain federal, state, and foreign tax attributes.
The federal valuation allowance maintained is due to limitations under Internal Revenue Code Section 382 or 383, separate return loss year rules, or dual consolidated loss rules.
Certain state and foreign valuation allowance maintained is due to lack of sufficient sources of future taxable income.

comparisons.peer_topic: Income taxes valuation allowance and realization
comparisons.peer_summary: Net deferred tax assets are recognized to the extent of probable realization based on positive and negative evidence, including projected taxable income and tax strategies, with valuation allowances adjusted accordingly.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Broadcom apply the 'more likely than not' standard to assess the realization of deferred tax assets and adjust valuation allowances accordingly. Intel determined it was more likely than not that its deferred tax assets would not be recoverable based on a three-year cumulative loss position. Broadcom recognizes net deferred tax assets to the extent they believe they will more likely than not be realized, considering all available positive and negative evidence including projected taxable income.

sentences.text: We assess the recoverability of our deferred tax assets quarterly, weighing available positive and negative evidence.

As a result of our assessment in the third quarter of 2024, we determined it was more likely than not that the deferred tax assets will not be recoverable based upon our three-year cumulative historical loss position as of the third quarter of 2024, largely resulting from the asset impairment and restructuring and other charges incurred during 2024.
We recognize net deferred tax assets to the extent we believe these assets will more likely than not be realized.

In making such determination, we consider all available positive and negative evidence, including scheduled reversals of deferred tax liabilities, projected future taxable income, tax planning strategies and recent financial operations.

comparisons.peer_topic: Deferred tax assets and valuation allowance assessment
comparisons.peer_summary: The company maintains a valuation allowance of $593 million against net deferred tax assets as of August 29, 2024 (up from $528 million in 2023), primarily for U.S. state and Malaysia carryforwards, with changes driven by management's assessment of the realizability of tax credits and net operating losses.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Micron assess the realizability of deferred tax assets using positive and negative evidence to determine if a valuation allowance is needed. Intel established a valuation allowance in Q3 2024 due to a three-year cumulative loss position. Micron maintains a valuation allowance of $593 million against net deferred tax assets, primarily for U.S. state and Malaysia carryforwards, with changes driven by management's assessment of the realizability of tax credits and net operating losses based on a 'more likely than not' threshold.

sentences.text: We assess the recoverability of our deferred tax assets quarterly, weighing available positive and negative evidence.

As a result of our assessment in the third quarter of 2024, we determined it was more likely than not that the deferred tax assets will not be recoverable based upon our three-year cumulative historical loss position as of the third quarter of 2024, largely resulting from the asset impairment and restructuring and other charges incurred during 2024.
We assess positive and negative evidence for each jurisdiction to determine whether it is more likely than not that existing deferred tax assets will be realized.

As of August 29, 2024, and August 31, 2023, we had a valuation allowance of $593 million and $528 million, respectively, against our net deferred tax assets, primarily related to carryforwards in U.S. states and Malaysia.

Changes in 2024 in the valuation allowance were due to adjustments based on management's assessment of the realizability of tax credits, allowances and net operating losses based on a level that is more likely than not to be realized.
